description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer IPC interface, specifically testing the getBufferAvailable method. It includes mock setups, test cases for success, failure, and reconnection scenarios, and uses Google Test framework features.

classes.name: RialtoClientWebAudioPlayerIpcGetBufferAvailableTest
classes.description: A test fixture class inheriting from WebAudioPlayerIpcTestBase, setting up and tearing down the WebAudio IPC environment for each test.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates WebAudio IPC, and allocates shared memory info.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, destroys WebAudio IPC, and performs base class teardown.
